jobs.title: Senior Lösningsarkitekt / Solution Architect - Malmö eller Kalmar
jobs.description:
Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för lösningar där verksamhetsbehov, komplexa systemlandskap och modern Microsoft-teknik behöver fungera tillsammans?  
CGI söker en erfaren Senior Lösningsarkitekt / Solution Architect till vårt team i Malmö eller Kalmar. Vi söker dig som är trygg i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och teknik och som kan omsätta komplexa behov till hållbara lösningar – från tidig dialog och arkitektur till genomförande.  
I rollen får du arbeta med lösningar där flera system, plattformar, integrationer och dataflöden behöver samspela. Du kommer nära både kunden och våra tekniska team och får en central roll i att skapa riktning, fatta lösningsbeslut och se till att helheten håller över tid.  
Du behöver ha ett tekniskt djup och förstå hur moderna lösningar byggs, men det här är inte en roll där du förväntas detaljstyra implementationen. Din styrka ligger i att se helheten, ställa rätt frågor och samla rätt kompetenser kring rätt lösning.

**Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter**

Som Senior Lösningsarkitekt arbetar du från verksamhetsbehov och krav till sammanhängande lösningsarkitektur.  
Du leder lösningsdiskussioner tillsammans med kund, verksamhet, utvecklingsteam, tekniska arkitekter och andra specialister. Du analyserar alternativ och beroenden och hjälper kunden att fatta välgrundade beslut utifrån verksamhetsnytta, teknik, kostnad och långsiktig förvaltning.  
Du kommer bland annat att:  

* designa och driva end-to-end-lösningar i komplexa systemlandskap
* omsätta verksamhetsbehov, processer och krav till hållbar lösningsarkitektur
* leda workshops, lösningsdiskussioner och arkitekturella vägval tillsammans med kund och tekniska team
* säkerställa att system, plattformar, integrationer och komponenter fungerar tillsammans som en helhet
* arbeta med integrationer, API, dataflöden och systemberoenden
* utvärdera lösningsalternativ och driva beslut från behov och målbild till realiserbar lösning
* vägleda och utmana utvecklare och tekniska arkitekter med stöd av din förståelse för systemutveckling, .NET och C#
* identifiera risker, beroenden och arkitekturella konsekvenser tidigt
* involvera rätt specialister och delegera tekniska frågeställningar till rätt kompetens
* kommunicera komplexa lösningar på ett begripligt sätt för både verksamhet, ledning och tekniska målgrupper.

**Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll**

Vem söker vi?  
Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet som Solution Architect, Lösningsarkitekt eller i en motsvarande senior arkitektroll och som har arbetat med lösningar där flera system och tekniska plattformar behöver fungera tillsammans.  
  
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:  

* senior erfarenhet av att designa och driva sammanhängande lösningar i komplexa systemlandskap
* förmåga att förstå verksamhetsprocesser och krav och omsätta dem till hållbara tekniska lösningar
* god förståelse för systemutveckling och .NET/C#, med tillräckligt tekniskt djup för att kunna utmana och vägleda utvecklingsteam och tekniska arkitekter
* erfarenhet av systemintegration, API, integrationsarkitektur och dataflöden
* förmåga att se hela lösningen och förstå beroenden mellan applikationer, plattformar och integrationer
* erfarenhet av att leda lösningsdiskussioner, utvärdera alternativ och driva arkitekturella beslut
* mycket god förmåga att kommunicera med såväl verksamhet och kund som utvecklare och tekniska specialister
* trygghet i att arbeta i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter, beroenden och förändrade förutsättningar
* mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Extra intressant är erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och Power Platform  
Vi ser det som starkt meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 och Power Platform, särskilt om du har designat lösningar där plattformarna behöver samverka med andra verksamhetssystem.  
Det kan exempelvis handla om lösningsarkitektur kring:  
Dynamics 365 • Power Platform • Power Apps • Power Automate • Dataverse • API Management • Integrationer • Azure  
  
Du behöver inte vara specialist eller utvecklare inom samtliga tekniker. Vi söker framför allt dig som förstår hur plattformarna kan användas som delar av en större lösning och hur integrationer, data och övriga verksamhetssystem behöver hänga ihop.  
  
Det är också meriterande om du har  

* erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och Microsofts bredare plattformsekosystem
* erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA, framför allt ur ett lösnings-, arkitektur- eller integrationsperspektiv
* erfarenhet av större digitaliserings- eller transformationsprogram där flera system, plattformar och verksamhetsområden berörs
* arbetat i miljöer där Microsoft-plattformar, ERP, CRM och andra verksamhetssystem behöver integreras till en sammanhängande lösning.

  
Vem är du?  
För oss är det viktigt att du kan skapa både riktning och samsyn.  
Du är lösningsorienterad och driver frågor framåt även när alla svar ännu inte finns på plats. Du kan snabbt skapa dig en bild av helheten och är pragmatisk när du behöver balansera verksamhetsnytta, tekniska möjligheter, tid, kostnad och långsiktig förvaltning.  
Du är kommunikativ och pedagogisk och kan växla mellan att diskutera verksamhetsprocesser med kunden och tekniska vägval med arkitekter och utvecklare.  
Samtidigt är du prestigelös. Du behöver inte själv äga varje teknisk detalj, utan vet när andra kompetenser ska involveras och får olika specialister att arbeta mot samma mål.  
  
Varför CGI?  
Hos CGI får du möjlighet att arbeta med affärskritiska lösningar och komplexa digitala transformationer hos några av våra kunder. Du får kombinera din arkitekturkompetens med CGI breda kompetens inom bland annat Microsoft, integration, ERP, cloud och verksamhetsutveckling.  
Som Senior Lösningsarkitekt får du möjlighet att påverka lösningen från tidigt skede och arbeta nära både kund och våra leveransteam.  
Du blir samtidigt en del av ett stort nätverk av arkitekter, utvecklare och specialister där vi delar kunskap och tillsammans löser komplexa utmaningar.  
  
Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta t.karlsson@cgi.com. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!  
  
#LI-HW1

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**  
  
Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.  
  
Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.  
  
Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.  
  
Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
  
  
Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

jobs.title: Systemutvecklare Fullstack
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Software Architect with a strong background in C#/.NET and a passion for building solutions that make a real difference? Join us at Epiroc and help shape the architecture behind innovative digital solutions for sustainable mining and construction. In this role, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with the ability to guide, mentor and bring others forward.

  

**It all starts with people. People like you.**

  

**Join our team**

You will join an IoT Platform organization - an international, diverse, and highly collaborative environment where software developers, architects, and product owners work side‑by‑side to enable the next generation of data‑driven solutions. Together, we build the platform that collects machine data and transforms it into real value for customers and internal stakeholders across Epiroc.

  

**Your mission**

First our product manager(s) define “the What”. Then a key part in this architect role will be to contribute with “the How”. Your mission is to take an active role in shaping and developing the software architecture within the teams while also staying close to the development work. You will work for solutions that are well designed, sustainable and aligned with both current and future needs. Together with our Lead Architect and fellow architect colleagues you will form a strong architectural team that relentlessly implements and follows up on a solid architectural roadmap and ways of working. This role will start to focus on one of our development teams and then gradually expand its responsibility towards several teams.

  

In this role, you will:

* Drive and contribute to good software architecture
* Support architectural discussions and technical decision-making
* Be involved in creating the architectural style and then heavily contributing towards the architectural patterns, design patterns and design principles
* Designs end-to-end IT solutions that align with business goals
* Work with C#/.NET IoT solutions such as file transfer, device management & data handling and more towards cloud rather than machine
* Collaborate closely with developers, teams and other internal stakeholders
* Contribute to continuous improvement and bring new perspectives into the team
* Balance hands-on contribution with guiding others in their technical development
* Designs software components and modules
* Set coding standards
* Solve technical challenges like code scalability, maintainability, security and performance

  

**Your profile**

You enjoy collaborating with others, sharing your knowledge and helping the team move forward while still contributing strongly to the technical delivery. You bring solid software architecture experience, new perspectives and a positive, engaging approach.

  

We believe you have:

* At least 5 years of experience as a software architect or in software development with a lead role in software architecture matters
* Experience working in roles where you have contributed to architectural direction, technical design, senior-level development or set up complex foundations that other teams could built their deliveries upon
* Very strong knowledge in C#/.NET
* The ability and interest to support developers
* Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset
* A positive and engaging approach

  

**Location and other**

This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. While we offer a hybrid workplace, you would be required to be in the office minimum of 3 days per week.

  

**Why Epiroc?**

By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth and lasting impact.

  

To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:

  

* Global career opportunities
* Learning & Development programs
* Benefits package, including variable compensation
* Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Community involvement

  

**Application and contact information**

We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 23, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date.

  

We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

  

For questions about the position, please contact:

Hiring Manager, Carl Slotte, carl.slotte@external.epiroc.com

  

For questions about the recruitment process, please contact:

Recruitment Specialist, Zuzana Matova, zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com

  

**It all starts with people.** The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www.epiroc.com

jobs.title: Masters Thesis Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
### **General Information**

**Locations**: Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden

Role ID

216110

Worker Type

Intern - Temporary Employee

Studio/Department

CT - Frostbite

Work Model

Hybrid

### **Description & Requirements**

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

**Contract:** 6-month internship

**Start Date:** Late January 2027

**Work Model:** Hybrid (3 days minimum onsite)

  
  

**The Challenge Ahead**

  
  

Frostbite is EA’s proprietary game engine, powering many of our leading titles across EA SPORTS, Battlefield, and more. We develop shared tools and technologies that connect and empower creators throughout EA. On Frostbite, you’ll collaborate with accomplished teams and contribute to the foundation that enables the creation of immersive, high-quality games for players worldwide.

  
  

As a Master's Thesis Intern, you will develop a project in an area where Frostbite's engineering efficiency can be multiplied with generative AI, agents, or context engineering. You will also gain an understanding of what it's like to work at EA. An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* You will investigate and prototype applying GenAI solutions to Frostbite's development process.
  
* You will review designs and implementations with other software engineers and will validate your results using a representative dataset.
  
* You will report to an engineering manager, attend meetings, present progress information and write a final report.
  

  

**Eligibility:**

* You are pursuing a MsC. in Computer Science (or a related field).
  
* You are associated with a university education or any other type of education in Sweden that has an internship period planned into the education plan.
  

  

**Skills:**

* You have experience with Python, C# or C++.
  
* You understand software development processes.
  
* You have an interest in applying GenAI to software engineering (e.g. GitHub, CoPilot).
  
* You have knowledge of AI concepts like knowledge graphs, vector databases, context engineering, MCP servers, LangChain, or RAG.
  
* You understand software quality, test automation, or CI/CD.
  

  

Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date CV and Cover Letter in **English**, explaining what project you would like to work on and explain your pick based on your interests and skills.

  

***About Electronic Arts***

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

  

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

  

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

**About the Team**

You will join a team within the R&D organization that develops innovative software solutions for our handheld battery products. You will be supporting both Advanced Development initiatives and core Drive Systems activities, playing a key role in shaping future products while continuously improving existing solutions.

**About the Role**

As a **Software Engineer**, you will contribute to pre-develop solutions and initiative, new product development and the maintenance and enhancement of existing products. You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where software, electronics, and mechanics come together to create high-performing handheld battery tools.

In this role, you will be closely involved in both software and product development, collaborating with skilled colleagues across different engineering disciplines. Experience in electrical motor control is considered a strong advantage.

You thrive in an environment where not every requirement is predefined and are comfortable taking ownership, driving initiatives forward, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

You have experience in embedded software development and can translate technical needs into robust, efficient, and maintainable software solutions.

University degree within software engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

A few years of experience in low level embedded software development. Experience within motor control and battery systems is a strong plus. Also knowledge in safety standards and cyber security (CRA etc.).

Arbeta nära komplexa system i en teknikintensiv miljö. Bidra inom både utveckling, integration och verifiering. Samarbeta med konstruktörer, utvecklare och testfunktioner. Det här kommer du göra Utveckla funktioner för runtimeplattformar och systemnära mjukvara.
  
  
Integrera, konfigurera och verifiera mjukvara i systemmiljöer. Automatisera infrastruktur, byggflöden och leveranser. Arbeta med nätverk, säkerhetskritisk mjukvara och virtualisering. Delta i teamets planering och tekniska problemlösning.

Intresse för både utveckling, integration och verifiering. Teknik & Verktyg Linux OS, servrar och driftmiljöer. Python, Bash, PowerShell och Bourne shell. Ansible, Kubernetes och Docker.

jobs.title: Performance Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Performance Test Engineer (Azure)

Short-term, Part-time contract

10 – 15 hours per week

**About us**
============

Sleep.ai is an AI-powered sleep platform on a mission to change the world through the power of sleep. We help companies build sleep insights, coaching and research-backed solutions into their products and services, and we power consumer products such as the SleepScore app. We have offices in San Diego, Dublin and Berlin.

We are seeing growing traction and interest, and the number of users joining our platform is climbing quickly. Our platform runs on Azure, using Function Apps, Storage Queues, Blob Storage and Table Storage. We need to understand where it will struggle as load grows, and what needs to change so it can scale.

**Learn more:** www.sleep.ai

**The role**
============

We are looking for an experienced Performance Test Engineer to assess the scalability, stability and responsiveness of our platform under varying load. You will identify bottlenecks, carry out root cause analysis and give us a clear, prioritised plan to resolve them.

You will lead the performance testing effort, working in close collaboration with our backend and DevOps teams to agree priorities, shape the approach and review findings. You will recommend appropriate tooling, with selections reviewed and approved by the engineering team to ensure they fit our platform and existing practices.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

* Define a performance testing strategy and test plans in collaboration with the backend and DevOps teams, covering load, stress, spike, soak/endurance and scalability scenarios
* Establish performance baselines and capacity limits for the current platform
* Build realistic user-journey and message-volume scenarios and execute them using load testing tools reviewed and approved by the engineering team (for example k6, JMeter, Gatling, Azure Load Testing or similar)
* Analyse Function App behaviour: cold starts, scale-out limits, concurrency settings and hosting plan suitability
* Analyse queue behaviour: throughput, backlog growth, poison messages, retry patterns and processing lag
* Analyse Blob and Table Storage behaviour: throttling, partition design, hot partitions, storage account scalability targets and latency under load
* Use observability and monitoring tooling (for example Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or similar) to trace requests, correlate metrics and pinpoint root causes
* Produce clear performance reports with findings, risks and prioritised recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Recommend fixes and, where agreed, help implement them, then re-test to confirm the improvement
* Define SLOs, regression thresholds and quality gates that can be built into our CI/CD pipeline

**Essential skills and experience**
===================================

* Proven experience as a Performance Test Engineer or Performance Engineer (typically 5+ years)
* Hands-on experience with performance testing tools (for example k6, JMeter, Gatling, NeoLoad or similar)
* Strong background in bottleneck analysis and troubleshooting on cloud-hosted distributed systems
* Solid working knowledge of Azure serverless and storage services: Functions, Storage Queues, Blob Storage and Table Storage
* Experience with APM and observability tooling (for example Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace or similar)
* Able to script in a language suited to the task (for example C#, JavaScript, Python or similar)
* Strong written communication skills, with the initiative to lead the work and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and DevOps teams

**Desirable**
=============

* Experience with cloud-based load testing services and CI/CD pipelines (for example Azure Load Testing, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar)
* Familiarity with messaging and data services that could form part of a future scale-up path (for example Service Bus, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Durable Functions or similar)
* Previous experience working with startups or scale-ups

**Engagement**
==============

**Type:** Contract, part-time

**Hours:** 10–15 hours per week

**Duration:** initial term, e.g. 8–12 weeks, with option to extend

**Location:** remote / hybrid, Ireland-based preferred

**Rate:** €35 – €50/Hour

**Reporting to:** Head of Quality Assurance

**Expected deliverables**
=========================

* A baseline performance report for the current platform
* A bottleneck and risk register, ranked by impact
* A scaling roadmap with recommended changes and effort estimates
* A reusable load test suite, ready to run in our pipeline

jobs.description:
**Curious about software development and subsea technology? Join Kongsberg Discovery as a Full-Stack SW Developer!**

Kongsberg Discovery is a global leader in advanced marine and subsea technologies. To meet an exciting and increasingly demanding future, we are seeking a new colleague to join our Positioning and Monitoring R&D department.

You will become part of the team responsible for HiPOS, our new software platform for operating and monitoring hydroacoustic positioning and communication systems. HiPOS supports demanding maritime operations by presenting positioning information and enabling interaction with hydroacoustic, inertial navigation and associated vessel systems.

Our solutions are used worldwide in demanding maritime operations within research, offshore energy, and other specialized applications.

More information can be found on our web site, search for products like HiPAP and cNODE:

KONGSBERG - an international technology group

**In this role**

You will contribute to the continued development of the HiPOS platform, primarily back-end software, system interfaces, operational user interfaces, and new functionality. You will work closely with experienced software developers, system engineers, testers, and product management in a multidisciplinary R&D environment. You will also:

* Build and improve end-to-end product features across frontend and backend
* Develop scalable backend services, APIs, integrations and data flows
* Contribute to software architecture, system design, security, release and technical specifications
* Troubleshoot and improve software performance, reliability, and usability
* Collaborate with colleagues across different technical disciplines
* Participate in product testing in our laboratories and aboard our research vessels in Horten
* Work closely with Product, UX, Platform, Data and DevOps colleagues to turn user and business needs into working software

**Required qualifications and experience**

* BSc or MSc in computer science, cybernetics, software engineering, or a related field
* Experience with application development using technologies such as C++, C#
* Real-time programming, real time operating systems
* Experience with DevOps tools and development pipelines
* Experience with software development principles, testing, and version control
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken

**Preferred qualifications and experience**

* Experience with software architecture, remote operation, networking, or cloud infrastructure is an advantage
* Relevant professional experience is preferred, but recent graduates with a strong technical background will also be considered

*This employment may require security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority, clearance through Civil Aviation Authority or a background check. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.*

**Personal Attributes**

We believe the ideal candidate:

* Is proactive, self-driven, and takes responsibility for assigned tasks
* Approaches problems methodically and systematically
* Enjoys learning new technologies and understanding complex systems
* Collaborates and communicates effectively within multidisciplinary teams
* Contributes ideas and identifies practical solutions to technical challenge
* Values software quality, reliability, and continuous improvement

At **KONGSBERG**, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

**What We Can Offer**

As a Full-Stack Software Developer at Kongsberg Discovery, you will play an important role in developing advanced positioning technology for demanding maritime applications. We offer:

* The opportunity to work with a new software platform and influence its future development
* Challenging technical assignments with real-world maritime applications
* An international and multidisciplinary working environment
* Access to experienced colleagues and strong technical communities
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* Competitive compensation, insurance, and pension schemes
* Flexible working hours and hybrid working arrangements
* The opportunity to contribute to sustainable ocean technology that protects people and planet

**Work location**

Horten. Lysaker may be considered as a work location, but it will be required to be at our Horten site when needed.

**Point of contact**

Henriette Melsom, Department Manager, tel: +4748883011

**About KONGSBERG**

KONGSBERG protects people and critical infrastructure – from deep sea to space.

We deliver advanced ocean and space technologies – from autonomous marine systems to satellites and data services – supporting sustainability, climate monitoring, infrastructure protection, and security. KONGSBERG also develop innovative technologies for defence, security, and surveillance markets, combining military and civilian expertise. Our defence and security solutions span missiles, weapon stations, air defence, command and control, and digital towers.

Today, we have more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and the Norwegian government controls about 50.01 percent of the shares.

**About Discovery**

The Discovery division develops technologies for sustainable ocean resource management, climate monitoring, critical infrastructure protection, and national security. Its technology platforms and solutions support offshore operations, fisheries, ocean research, maritime operations, sea-based energy production, and naval defence. Products include sonars, underwater communication equipment, satellites, surveillance and positioning systems, and autonomous vehicles. Customers span offshore, fisheries, marine research, maritime, energy, surveillance, defence, and naval sectors.

TV productions around the world run on software built in Bergen.

Live every day, from BBC News to Premier League.

Viz Trio is the graphics application used by newsrooms and sports broadcasters to create and put content on air, and we are growing the team that builds it.

We're looking for a senior engineer who is energized by hard systems problems and cares about building the right thing, not just shipping the next thing.

**The challenge**

Viz Trio is a large Delphi and C# application that has run live broadcasts around the world for more than two decades, and we are modernizing it while it stays on air.

That means:

* Re-engineering parts of a mature system built on technologies from different generations
* Improving Delphi/C# interop and carefully migrating selected Delphi code to C#
* Integrating new web-based UI components

This is the kind of problem most engineers never get to touch: deep, real, consequential, and visible on screen.

We want someone who finds that exciting rather than daunting.

OneSubsea is a world‑leading provider of subsea technology, enabling efficient utilization of energy resources and accelerating the transition to a more sustainable future.

We are now looking for a **Control System Software Engineer** to join our team in **Bergen, Sandsli**.

#### **About the role**

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most advanced subsea production systems in the world. As a Control Systems Engineer with SLB OneSubsea, you're not just designing control logic, you're helping to enable the safe and efficient operation of subsea energy infrastructure that operates thousands of meters below the ocean surface.

You'll work with cutting-edge subsea control systems, automation, communications, and power distribution technologies. The role combines software, hardware, systems engineering, and real-world operational challenges, making it highly technical and intellectually stimulating.

SLB OneSubsea offers a unique environment where engineers are involved throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept development and design to testing, commissioning, and field support. This means you can see the direct impact of your work on major global projects.

The company also has a strong international footprint, giving you exposure to global teams, customers, and projects. If you're looking for a role where you can develop both deep technical expertise and broader project and customer-facing skills, this is a great platform.

#### **Key responsibilities include**

* Designing, implementing, and testing control system software for subsea systems

* Performing modifications and upgrades to delivered control systems through aftermarket activities

* Participating in component, functional, system, and interface testing

* Working closely with suppliers during testing activities at supplier locations

* Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams across all project phases

* Supporting implementation and handover of control system software for subsea products and systems

#### **We are looking for someone who**

Is excited by the opportunity to work with industry-leading subsea technology and contribute to solutions that support a more sustainable energy future. This role offers the chance to tackle complex engineering challenges while collaborating with highly skilled colleagues across multidisciplinary teams in an environment that values knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous development.

The ideal candidate holds as a minimum a BSc in automation, cybernetics, computer science, IT, or a related engineering discipline. Experience with PLC-based control systems is considered a strong advantage, however we also value relevant practical experience and transferable skills and encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds to apply.

#### **Required experience**

* Has minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience

* Is fluent in English, both spoken and written

* Has a positive, practical, and solution-oriented mindset with high drive and strong capacity to deliver

* Can work both independently and as part of multidisciplinary teams

#### **It is a bonus if you have**

* Experience with Rockwell Automation products (e.g. Allen-Bradley PLCs or FactoryTalk View HMI software)

* Experience with Hyper-V virtualization or VMware solutions

* Experience with Microsoft Windows Server

* Understanding of quality assurance and software testing methods

* Knowledge of HTML5 and modern visualization/presentation tools

* Use of AI tools to support development and improve workflows

#### **With us, you will experience**

* Collaboration with highly qualified engineers working with leading energy companies worldwide

* A dynamic workday where you influence technical solutions and outcomes

* An international work environment that values initiative and innovation

* Varied tasks across projects, customers, and technologies

* Flexible working arrangements, including home‑office opportunities

* Modern facilities at Sandsli, including parking, in‑house gym, and high‑quality cafeteria

* Strong development opportunities within OneSubsea and SLB

#### **Interested?**

To be considered for this position, please attach:

* CV in English

* Transcripts of Records or other documentation detailing education and grades

Applications missing this documentation will not be considered.

#### **Diversity and Inclusion**

At OneSubsea, we see our diverse workforce as a great advantage. We promote an inclusive work environment where equal opportunities, diversity, and inclusion are key to our success. We believe that diversity enriches us, attracts talent, and makes working life more exciting. Therefore, we encourage all candidates to apply - regardless of background, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, disability, or age.

**Om bedriften**
----------------

OneSubsea is a world-leading provider of subsea technology, enabling efficient utilization of energy resources and accelerating the transition to a more sustainable future.

SLB, OneSubsea processing, Aker Solutions, and Subsea7 have come together to create the world’s leading subsea technology and solutions provider.

We are focused on accelerating innovation to create a step change in subsea production economics and reduce emissions in subsea operations.

The joint venture brings together deep reservoir domain expertise, broad front-end and system design knowledge.

We provide an extensive field-proven subsea production and processing technology portfolio, world-class manufacturing scale and capacity, and unique pore-to-process integration capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack App Developer
jobs.description:
**Joining Team Norse is more than getting a job. It is all about belonging.**

Always dreamt of doing things differently? Join us in Comtech at Norse Atlantic Airways, where we build the digital products behind a challenger airline.

We think differently and we act differently. We are not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and test new ideas. We are a data-driven, product-first organization powered by a small, tight-knit team of developers, product managers and data scientists — plus a few potatoes.

If these prospects inspire you, then we want to talk to you!

Potatoes: a Norwegian term for people who can do a little bit of everything.

**Why This Role is Exciting**

Our Flutter app is at the heart of Norse's digital experience, and we're looking for someone to take real ownership of it. You'll be the driving force behind the mobile app while working shoulder-to-shoulder with a small engineering team — which means your day won't stop at the app. In a lean team, the best people wear more than one hat, so you'll also jump in to support the wider stack: our GraphQL layer, our .NET / C# backend services, and the integrations that hold it all together. Your heart is in app development, but your reach goes across the whole product.

This role sits within Comtech and reports to the Head of Ecom and Product.  
  
**Responsibilities and Duties**

Flutter App Development (your main focus)

* Own the design, development and maintenance of our cross-platform mobile app in Flutter and Dart, delivering a high-performing, scalable and user-friendly experience on both iOS and Android.
* Drive the app's architecture and set best practices for state management, testing and release, keeping the codebase clean and maintainable.
* Partner with UX/UI designers to build intuitive, engaging interfaces, and iterate based on user testing and experimentation.
* Optimize app performance — load times, responsiveness and stability — across a wide range of devices.

Backend & Fullstack Support

* Roll up your sleeves alongside the rest of the team to support our general stack, contributing to backend services built with .NET Core and C#.
* Design, consume and extend GraphQL APIs that connect the app and web front-ends to our backend systems.
* Help design robust, secure and reliable integrations, ensuring smooth communication between the app, the backend and third-party services.
* Support and unblock fellow engineers across the stack — reviewing code, pairing and stepping in wherever the team needs an extra pair of hands.

Architecture & Collaboration

* Take ownership of end-to-end delivery, from architecture through to deployment, following clean architecture principles.
* Work within Agile Scrum, participating in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives with product managers, designers and fellow engineers.
* Collaborate closely with a cross-functional team to ship a best-in-class product, fast.

Code Review, Mentorship & Innovation

* Conduct thorough code reviews and champion high coding standards across the app and the wider stack.
* Mentor and support other developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
* Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends, proposing and implementing ideas that push our products forward.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 5+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on mobile development in Flutter and Dart.
* Proven experience shipping and maintaining production mobile apps on iOS and Android.
* Solid backend experience with .NET Core and C#, and comfort working across a fullstack codebase.
* Hands-on experience with GraphQL (designing, consuming or extending APIs).
* Experience with RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* A passion for clean, maintainable and scalable code, and strong problem-solving and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile teams, and a startup mindset that thrives in a small, high-ownership team.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (desired but not required).

**AI-Assisted Development**

* Proficient with AI-assisted and agentic software development tools such as Claude Code — or able to become proficient very quickly — using them effectively for coding, codebase exploration, refactoring, debugging, testing, code review and engineering automation.
* Comfortable designing workflows where AI agents can safely perform or accelerate repetitive engineering tasks, while applying appropriate review and engineering judgment.
* Actively explores new AI-assisted development practices and helps establish effective patterns for using them across the team.

**Why Join Comtech?**

**Take real ownership of a product used by travelers around the world.**

* Work in an innovative, fast-paced environment where your work truly matters.
* Get access to leading AI development tools, with their use encouraged as part of the normal development workflow — we're building a modern, highly productive small engineering team.
* Flexible work arrangements at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.
* Enjoy the same great staff travel benefits as employees across Norse Atlantic Airways.
* Join a dynamic and international team building the future of airline travel.

**This position is located at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.**

**Here's a taste of what life in Arendal and Southern Norway has to offer:**

**www.visitsorlandet.com**

**www.gotoarendal.com**

**www.welcomehub.no**

**www.businessregionkristiansand.no**

**If you're ready to take ownership of our app and help build something that matters in the airline industry, we'd love to hear from you!**

**We believe that culture will be our competitive advantage.**

Team Norse has identified three core values that we all should live and breathe.  
They are:

* Be inclusive
* Take ownership
* Show kindness.

**Deadline to apply : 15 October.**

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to send an email to: careers@flynorse.com

Please note: you have 2 days from submission to edit your cover letter before it can no longer be changed.

**OUR ROLE**

In this role, you will be at the forefront of creating cutting-edge designs that elevate our product offerings and meet the evolving needs of our consumers. You will collaborate with a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and technology.

Fiskars Group values creativity and independence, providing an environment where non-standardized work and complex challenges are the norm. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, including industrial designers, product managers, and marketing experts, and liaise with our global factories and suppliers.

If you are passionate about engineering, thrive in solving intricate problems, and seek to contribute to a heritage-rich company committed to design and functionality in lifestyle products, Fiskars Group is the place for you.

This position is based either in Espoo or Billnäs factory, Finland and reports to our Senior Manager, R&D. The role is full-time and is hybrid.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO AT FISKARS GROUP**

* With limited supervision, using conceptual design and 3D CAD modelling, design products that meet the objective of the project proposal and can be implemented within performance and cost constraints. jobs.title: Technical Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

**Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen**

**Technical Solution Architect – .NET, Microservices & Integrations**

Are you a technically strong Solution Architect who can turn complex system landscapes into robust, maintainable solutions – while remaining close enough to the code to guide implementation?

Twoday is looking for an experienced Technical Solution Architect for a permanent position in our Digital Engineering business unit. Your first assignment will be with a major Danish public-sector organisation in Copenhagen, where you will help shape solutions across multiple business-critical systems, integrations and delivery partners.

**Your role**

You will act as a trusted technical adviser to the customer and help ensure that proposed solutions are technically sound, realistic and aligned with the wider system landscape.

This is not a purely strategic or documentation-focused architecture role. You must understand the technology in depth, engage directly with developers and contribute actively from clarification and solution design through implementation and operation.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Designing scalable solutions based on .NET, microservices, APIs and asynchronous messaging
* Understanding complex system landscapes, dependencies and technical constraints
* Driving technical clarifications across system owners, development teams and external suppliers
* Assessing, challenging and improving solution recommendations from delivery partners
* Defining clear service boundaries, interfaces, integration patterns and data ownership
* Ensuring robust error handling, retries, idempotency and traceability across distributed systems
* Supporting developers through technical sparring, design reviews and code-level discussions
* Contributing to architecture decisions, technical documentation and implementation plans
* Ensuring that operations, monitoring, logging, security and maintainability are addressed from the outset
* Promoting automated testing, CI/CD and efficient delivery practices
* Using AI-assisted development tools to increase delivery speed without compromising quality, security or correctness

**What we are looking for**

You have several years of experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Lead or senior software engineer with significant architectural responsibility. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate clearly and move complex discussions towards concrete decisions.

**We expect you to have:**

* A strong hands-on background in C# and modern .NET
* Experience with microservices, distributed systems and integration-heavy solutions
* Solid experience designing and implementing REST APIs
* Experience with message-based integration, preferably RabbitMQ or comparable technologies
* A practical understanding of retries, dead-letter handling, idempotency, ordering and duplicate messages
* Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing
* Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing and operational troubleshooting
* The ability to translate business and technical requirements into workable solution designs
* Experience advising customers and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* The confidence to challenge proposed solutions constructively and explain technical trade-offs
* Experience coordinating dependencies across teams, systems or external suppliers
* A structured and independent approach, with ownership from initial clarification to implementation
* Practical experience using AI tools as part of software development

Experience from public-sector or other complex, regulated environments is an advantage.

**Practical requirements**

* **You are fluent in Danish, both spoken and written**
* **You can work full time onsite with the customer in Copenhagen**
* You are interested in permanent employment with Twoday
* We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible

**About Twoday**

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will play a central role with exciting opportunities to grow within an international and innovative group, working on cutting-edge technology and software solutions. You will also have the flexibility to occasionally work from one of our main offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki or Vilnius.

**Diversity & inclusion**

Do you not meet all the requirements? Studies show that women and minorities are less likely to apply for a job if they don’t meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on.

We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it.

Tech stack you will be working with

* C# and .NET, TypeScript, React
* AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
* Event driven services and large scale data pipelines
* GitHub Actions for CI and CD
* Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC

### **What we will be doing**

* Contribute to the technical direction of the team. Write the system designs for the work you own, take part in design reviews, and argue for the option you believe is right.
* Design and build systems yourself: services, APIs and data pipelines that stay stable, fast and affordable as data volumes grow.
* Lead our use of AI across the product development lifecycle. Take a product requirements document to a technical vision and system designs, break it into epics and user stories that an agent can act on, and set the standard at each step.
* Improve the scaffolding that makes agent driven delivery work: context and instruction files, prompts and skills, and the review and testing practice that keeps quality high when code arrives faster than before.
* Keep search data trustworthy, with tests, monitoring and errors a colleague can understand.
* Define how we measure quality, detect drift, and explain results to customers who make decisions based on them.
* Mentor engineers at all levels through design reviews, pairing and written technical proposals, including how to work well with agents.
* Treat cost, performance and operability as design inputs from the start.
* Take part in the daily work of the team: refinement, estimation, prototyping, debugging and production support.
* Travel may be required; a valid passport is required
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **What we will require of you**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.
* 10 or more years of professional software development experience.
* 5 or more years building and running services and APIs on a public cloud, preferably AWS.
* A track record of architecture decisions that span several teams, including the trade offs you rejected and why.
* You have owned features or services end to end, including what happened after they were released.
* Hands on experience using coding agents in real production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they do not.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms and data structures, and a commitment to technical excellence.
* Excellent written and verbal English. You write proposals and designs that other people, and agents, can act on without a meeting.

### **What we will love about you**

* Experience turning product requirements into technical designs and a delivery plan that a team can execute.
* Experience with search, SEO, crawling, indexing, ranking or web scale data.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Accessibility
jobs.description:
Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work.

### **What we will be doing**

* Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.
* Lead the people. Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.
* Stay hands-on enough to be credible. Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.
* Coach the team in AI-assisted development. Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.
* Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted. Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.
* Partner with Product and Design as equals. Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.
* Work across teams. Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.
* Protect engineering health. Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.
* Own quality and operational responsibility. Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.
* Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States. This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.
* Travel may be required; a valid passport is required
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **What we will require of you**

* Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.
* A real software engineering background. You have built and shipped production software yourself and can still read a pull request, follow a design discussion and form your own view. We will talk about systems you have built.
* Depth in at least one of our core languages, and comfort across the rest. Our services are written mainly in C# and .NET, TypeScript and JavaScript, Go, Rust and Python. You do not need all of them; you do need to be genuinely strong in one and unafraid of the others.
* Modern cloud and delivery practice. AWS, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, observability and on-call practice.
* Practical use of AI in the software lifecycle. You have personally used AI coding assistants and agents on real work, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you have opinions about how their output should be reviewed. Experience helping other engineers adopt them is what sets this role apart.
* Strong partnership with Product. A track record of working with Product Managers and Designers as a peer, shaping scope rather than receiving it.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical audience.
* Willingness to work a shifted day. Regular overlap with US Pacific time, and occasional travel.

### **What we will love about you**

* Digital accessibility knowledge. Familiarity with WCAG, assistive technology, or the accessibility conformance and reporting that regulated customers require. If you do not have it, you must be willing to learn it properly — it is the product.
* Experience in a compliance or regulated environment, such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a public-sector authorisation, and comfort working inside an audited change process.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Bioinformatics Scientist (AI-guided protein engineering)
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

**Why us**

Illumina is the global leader in Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) technology. Through relentless innovation, Illumina has reduced the cost of sequencing a human genome from hundreds of thousands of dollars to below $200. The drastic cost reduction has moved NGS from the laboratory to the clinic, with wide-ranging impact from cancer diagnostics to genetic testing. We invite you to join us in our effort to improve human health by unlocking the power of the genome.

**Position summary**

We are seeking a Senior Staff Scientist to help build computational tools and data foundation for our protein engineering group across global enzyme engineering programs. This role will connect data structures for high-throughput and mid-throughput screening, participate in method development and evaluation, and help establish semi-closed-loop and closed-loop design-build-test-learn workflows.

  

The successful candidate will provide senior technical leadership at the interface of protein engineering, AI/ML design, screening data systems, automation, and experimental execution. This scientist will define how screening results become reusable data assets as well as how computational methods are benchmarked and adopted.

The role is based in Singapore. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of Illumina’s continued growth.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Build reusable data foundations for protein engineering. Define data structures, metadata standards, variant lineage, assay context, controls, replicate handling, uncertainty, and negative data capture across high- and mid-throughput screening workflows.
* Enable model-guided enzyme engineering. Develop and evaluate computational workflows that connect sequence, structure, assay, and screening datasets to AI/ML models, design rationale, variant prioritization, and next-round library design.
* Benchmark computational and AI methods. Assess internal pipelines, open-source methods, commercial protein design platforms, and emerging scientific agents using retrospective and prospective performance metrics relevant to enzyme engineering programs.
* Deliver practical tools for project teams. Create reusable scripts, templates, dashboards, lightweight applications, and analysis pipelines that help experimental and computational teams run routine analyses and interpret recommendations efficiently.
* Advance closed-loop DBTL workflows. Help establish semi-closed-loop and closed-loop design-build-test-learn systems in which experimental results are captured, analyzed, modeled, reviewed, and converted into actionable design recommendations.
* Partner across global engineering programs. Work closely with experimental scientists, automation teams, informatics, software engineering, data engineering, chemists, biophysicists, and platform teams to ensure computational workflows align with assay throughput, operational constraints, and program goals.

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities.

**Education, Experience & Attributes required:**

* Ph.D. in computational chemistry, computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science or related fields, or equivalent work & educational experience.
* Significant experience leading computational biology, protein engineering, AI/ML, screening analytics, or scientific data infrastructure efforts
* Deep experience applying computational or data-driven methods to protein engineering, enzyme engineering, directed evolution, assay analysis, or related biological design problems.
* Demonstrated ability to design data structures or analytical systems that support reproducible analysis, model training, and cross-project learning.
* Wet-lab experience in high-throughput or mid-throughput screening and/or biochemical assay designs.
* Solid programming skills in at least one of the major programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, R).
* In-depth knowledge of protein sequence or structure modelling, protein-ligand interaction predictions and/or molecular simulations.
* Understanding of AI/ML methods and practical experience in adopting AI/ML-driven protein-design models.
* Strong fundamentals in statistical modelling, algorithm design, data analysis, and/or visualization methods.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Collaborative, open and self-aware, team player, and able to rapidly integrate into cross functional teams.
* Highly motivated individual with proven ability in thinking innovatively and the proven track record of productive research and development.

Strong applicants with lesser experience will be considered for a position commensurate with the experience.  



**Preferred experiences and attributes**

* Experience with foundational AI/ML models and protein language models for protein engineering, including generative protein design, zero-shot variant scoring, supervised learning, model-guided library design, denoising and uncertainty-aware learning, and multi-parameter optimization of protein properties

* Experience with structure prediction, protein-ligand or enzyme-substrate modeling, molecular dynamics, docking, or biophysical analysis (e.g. Protein MPNN, RFdiffusion, Boltz, Alphafold)

* Experience developing data standards, assay schemas, dashboards, or lightweight tools for experimental scientists.

* Experience with developing AI agents and agentic workflows for method and application development, and automatic execution and optimization of computational pipelines,
* Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX
* Large-scale biological data analysis using cloud or high-performance computing environments
* Practical experience with AI/ML model development for protein design.
* Experience with experiments within protein engineering, e.g. directed-evolution, high-throughput screening.
* Experience in using one or more commonly used molecular modelling software, e.g. Rosetta.
* Knowledge of best software development practices and code version control, e.g. Git.
* Knowledge of UNIX environment and shell scripting.
* Experience with high-performance computing, job schedulers, and/or GPU computing.
* Broad knowledge of bioinformatics, genomics, and/or proteomics database, tools, and/or algorithms.
* Knowledge of biochemistry, enzymology, and/or molecular biology.
Familiarity with next generation sequencing technologies, tools, and/or workflows.  

  
We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).

DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.

**JOB SUMMARY**

  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Studio (DIS), the role will manage DIS’s proof-of-concept (POC) platforms consisting of multi-cloud sandbox environments and maintain full technical understanding of their AI and/or IT standards. The candidate will undertake important technical activities together with NHG project teams for the robust prototyping of digital solutions that support CHI’s digital and AI-enabled future.

  

In addition, the candidate will participate in user-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.

**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

1. **Technical Prototype Engineering**

* Design and support the development of lightweight prototypes, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and workflow components.
* Collaborate with project teams to define technical requirements and translate business needs into implementable solution designs, ensuring alignment with security and scalability considerations.
* Develop technical documentation such as PRDs that include human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflow and guardrail/safety mechanisms, and architecture diagrams.
* Provide hands-on support for prototype development, testing, and technical troubleshooting.

**2. Sandbox Platform Management**
----------------------------------

* Maintain DIS multi-cloud sandbox environments across AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including user onboarding, resource provisioning, and access management .
* Manage and optimise additional enterprise prototyping platforms, ensuring users can effectively build solutions using pre-established services and reusable architecture patterns.
* Engage industry cloud providers and healthcare IT vendors to stay abreast of emerging platforms, integration approaches, and capabilities, and advise project teams on designing prototypes aligned with target deployment environments.
  

**3. Administrative support**

* Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
* Design and deliver hands-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud-based tools and platforms.
  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

  

(A) EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 5 years hands-on engineering experience (front-end or back-end in cloud environment).
* Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low-code/no-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Proficient in drafting PRDs and creating pragmatic lightweight solution architectures to guide technical implementation
  

**Desired Skills**

* Passion for healthcare and to create new solutions that can benefit patients or hospital systems.
* Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
* Flexible mindset to adopt new platforms and create new technical frameworks or processes in our evolving environment

Through technology-driven creativity, we enable meaningful business transformation. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying robust web applications that leverage cloud services.

Are you a technically minded student or a professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and making sure things are configured correctly?

You'll support our **Cabin Management System** team as an **Application Engineer** by processing aircraft configuration requests, working with technical documentation, and communicating with suppliers to ensure customer requirements are implemented accurately.

*Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.*

*As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com*  
*Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.*

* Object-oriented programming experience of OO design principles, 4+ years experience in C++ software development
