Location: Athens

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: 1 Oct 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1739003

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a team which has been announced as Top Employer for the third consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for a second year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the first time!

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams

Join our continuously growing team, which employs over 2.600 professionals in Greece, to experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, and Thessaloniki and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

We are currently seeking highly motivated people for our Technology Consulting practice to work either in Athens or Patras, which is a leading provider of services to the financial industry and large corporate clients of all industries.

You will work in multi-disciplinary teams to provide a broad range of information technology-related services, such as IT strategy and architecture, IT implementation support, and software design/development. Team members include professionals with a variety of backgrounds, including excellent academic credentials in quantitative sciences, IT, engineering, business, and economics, as well as deep professional experience in Greece and abroad.

As an IT Professional, you will contribute technical insight to client engagements and internal projects, as well as supervise more junior members of the team, in Greece and abroad. In line with EY's commitment to quality, you will ensure that your work is of the highest quality.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* In-depth understanding of Object-Oriented design/programming, familiarity with commonly used design patterns (DI, Repository, Service, Mediator) and the SOLID principles.
* Proven working experience in application development using the .NET Framework in C# (ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework/Dapper).
* Solid understanding of relational databases and experience working with at least one RDMS (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Working knowledge of versioning and source control systems. Hands-on experience with Git is considered especially important.

  

Skills and attributes for success

* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s and preferably a master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology/Systems or other related field with strong quantitative focus.
* At least 2 years of working experience as a .NET Software Engineer
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills in both Greek and English.

  

Ideally, you’ll also

What we look for

* Experience with Azure cloud technologies and DevOps practices.

* Experience with containers (Docker) and orchestration (K8S) services.

* IT-related professional qualifications or certifications.

**What we offer you**

**Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:**

* Developing your professional growth:

* You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects, through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success.

* Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. These advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before.

* Empowering your personal fulfilment: We focus on your financial, social, mental and physical wellbeing.

* Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club card that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.

* Our flexible working arrangement (hybrid model) is defined based on your own preferences and team’s needs, and we enjoy other initiatives such as summer short Fridays and an EY Day Off.

* Our commitment to a sustainable way of operating, encourages volunteerism, promotes sustainable practices and offers opportunities for you to create a positive societal impact.

* Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 3 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).

* Fueling an inclusive culture: We prioritize a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment, where you’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer for Marketing New
jobs.description:
Ghent, Belgium

  

**Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?**

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

**Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light**

We are **Lumineers**. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

* **Pursuit of greatness**: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
* **Meaningful work matters**: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

**Job Details**

* Marketing
* Belgium
* Full-Time/Hybrid

**What you will do**

You will join as a **Senior AI Solutions Engineer for Marketing**, focused on transforming our internal operations. You will be at the forefront of using AI to solve complex business problems, optimize workflows with AI agents, design and build integrations for business scalability. This is a future-proof role where you will build innovative solutions and have a direct impact on how our business operates as a key part of a new, decentralized team of AI specialists.

**Where you will have impact**

* Design and implement AI solutions that solve real-world business problems within our Marketing teams.
* Collaborate directly with domain experts to deeply understand business challenges, workflows, and opportunities for automation and improvement.
* Design, build, and operate AI agent workflows and integrations to optimize our marketing operations for scalability.
* Act as a key member of the broader cross-functional AI engineering team, sharing knowledge, best practices, and successful patterns.
* Work closely with our central AI infrastructure engineers to build robust and scalable solutions.
* Pitch your own ideas and co-create the roadmap for AI adoption within your domain, helping us build the perfect solutions.
* Drive projects with a solution-oriented and outcome-focused mindset, ensuring technology delivers tangible business value.

**About our team**

Lighthouse Marketing is a global team of creative thinkers who blend the art and science of marketing to amplify the brand, drive revenue, and deliver great marketing experiences. We work across time-zones, we focus on the metrics that matter, and we push each other to continually raise the bar. We embrace a customer-first approach to marketing and continually look for points of friction in the funnel that marketing can help to solve. We are on the lookout for new growth levers, we encourage experimentation, and we embrace a culture of learning and growth.

**What's in it for you?**

* Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
* Career development: Workshops, frameworks, and trainings to maximize your professional potential.
* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Mobility options: Mobility budget or company car (based on your job category).
* Net allowance: Support for home office related expenses.
* Vouchers: Lunch vouchers & Eco vouchers.
* Comprehensive health insurance: Extensive coverage for you and your dependents.
* Pension funding: Group insurance to secure your future.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* A strong background in Software Engineering and Integration Engineering.
* Hands-on experience experimenting with various AI tools and building out new, AI-driven workflows in production.
* Proven business understanding and experience working in a business-facing role.
* A solution-oriented and outcome-driven mindset, focused on solving problems rather than just pure engineering craftsmanship.
* A hands-on and curious nature, with an interest in learning and understanding complex business processes.
* Fluent communication in English.

### **We welcome**

* Familiarity with Marketing technology - Salesforce, Hubspot or similar tools.
* Experience building on top of LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) in a production context.
* Experience with data platforms such as BigQuery or similar.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: QA Project Engineer MES
jobs.description:
**What is offered?**
--------------------

At MindCapture you are not just starting a new role. You are joining a community that invests in your development and gives you the opportunity to grow in a meaningful technical career within healthcare.

You can count on:

* A competitive salary with a full benefits package including meal vouchers, eco vouchers, health insurance, group insurance, net expense allowance and a company car with charging or fuel card
* Personal growth support with tailored training and clear career development
* A stable environment where your technical skills directly contribute to improved patient care
* The chance to work with high tech diagnostic systems at top tier healthcare institutions
* A warm and collaborative culture focused on trust, ownership and long term impact

**Job description**
-------------------

As QA Project Engineer MES, you will oversee assigned Quality deliverables from planning through completion. Your primary focus will be reviewing verification documentation for electronic master batch records within the manufacturing execution system. You will collaborate across Quality, Operations, IT and project functions to ensure compliant and timely delivery.

**Key responsibilities**

* Quality oversight: Oversee verification activities according to approved procedures, priorities and timelines.
* Documentation review: Review checklists, design specifications, testing strategies and verification protocols.
* Verification: Review executed protocols and supporting evidence while following comments through resolution.
* Project documentation: Review traceability matrices, qualification documentation, quality plans, summary reports and implementation documentation.
* Data integrity: Support Quality oversight of master data, electronic batch records and manufacturing system elements.
* Compliance: Confirm deliverables meet GMP, data integrity and internal procedural requirements.
* Risk management: Identify and follow up risks, deviations, test observations and associated actions.
* Continuous improvement: Contribute to improvements across digital Quality processes and ways of working.
* Stakeholder alignment: Provide clear updates and escalate issues appropriately.
* Inspection readiness: Maintain complete, accurate and inspection ready documentation.

**Required competences & skills**
---------------------------------

* Education: Bachelor or master degree in bioengineering, pharmacy or another relevant technical or scientific field.
* Industry experience: At least three years of cross functional pharmaceutical industry experience.
* GMP knowledge: Sound knowledge of current GMP requirements and relevant pharmaceutical regulations.
* Batch records: Practical experience with master batch records and Quality within a GMP production environment.
* Verification experience: Experience reviewing batch record verification or qualification documentation is a plus.
* Manufacturing systems: Experience with manufacturing execution systems in production environments is a plus.
* Analytical skills: Strong analytical and decision making capabilities with a solution oriented mindset.
* Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to align different stakeholders.
* Independence: Ability to work independently while building effective cross functional relationships.

**Quality & Compliance**

**Ghent**

**Medior**

**At MindCapture as consultant**

This opportunity is offered through MindCapture as a consultancy role with strong day to day ownership. You will be placed on site with our client.

MindCapture supports you throughout your assignment with clear onboarding, regular follow up and access to learning opportunities. You will have a dedicated point of contact, transparent communication and support to help you deliver impact in a structured way.

**Job Contact –** **Talent & Business Team**
--------------------------------------------

Our Talent & Business Managers combine a deep understanding of our clients’ needs with a sharp eye for talent. Their focus is on creating meaningful and sustainable matches, always keeping both the role and the candidate in mind.

When a potential match is identified, one of our T&B colleagues may reach out to answer your questions, share additional context about the role and discuss possible next steps together, with clarity and transparency throughout the process.

**How our application process works**
-------------------------------------

* **Apply online** – Submit your application in just a few clicks.

jobs.title: Databricks Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Data Engineer**

Bouw jij graag end-to-end data pipelines en dataplatformen op Databricks?

Vertaal je complexe businessvragen moeiteloos naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen?

Ken jij Databricks van Auto Loader tot Unity Catalog en van Notebook tot Asset Bundle?

Dan ben **jij** de Databricks Data Engineer die we zoeken!

**Jouw impact**

Als Databricks Data Engineer bij EpicData zorg je ervoor dat data toegankelijk, schaalbaar en waardevol wordt. Je denkt én bouwt mee aan oplossingen die zowel technisch als functioneel kloppen, met het Databricks Data Intelligence Platform als fundament, meestal op Azure maar evengoed op AWS of GCP.

Je zet end-to-end lakehouse-platformen op: van ingestie met Auto Loader en Lakeflow Connect, over batch- en streamingtransformaties in PySpark en Spark SQL, tot een goed beheerde medallion-architectuur in Delta Lake onder Unity Catalog. Daarnaast adviseer je klanten over hoe ze Databricks slim, veilig en kostenbewust inzetten, en neem je die rol op als teamspeler, inhoudelijk expert of technische lead, net wat de situatie vraagt.

Kortom: jij bent de schakel tussen data en business, en de lakehouse is jouw werkterrein.

**Wat ga je doen?**

**Data toegankelijk maken op Databricks**

* Robuuste batch- en streamingpipelines bouwen met Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (voorheen Delta Live Tables), Auto Loader en Structured Streaming
* Transformaties uitwerken in PySpark en Spark SQL, bovenop Delta-tabellen, en ze orkestreren met Lakeflow Jobs of Azure Data Factory
* Verschillende, vaak rommelige databronnen samenbrengen tot één overzichtelijk geheel, met ingebouwde datakwaliteitsregels (expectations)
* Een medallion-architectuur (bronze, silver, gold) opzetten en beheren in Unity Catalog
* Datamodellen ontwerpen, van klassiek dimensioneel volgens Kimball tot modellen die klaarstaan voor Databricks SQL, Power BI of AI/BI-dashboards

**De brug zijn tussen data en business**

* Datamodellen ontwerpen, van klassiek dimensioneel volgens Kimball tot modellen die klaarstaan voor Databricks SQL, Power BI of AI/BI-dashboards
* Meedenken over workspace-opzet, Unity Catalog-governance, toegangsbeheer en Delta Sharing
* Meebeslissen over de juiste aanpak, of dat nu als teamspeler, expert of technisch aanspreekpunt is
* Technische keuzes vertalen naar taal die niet-technische collega's en klanten begrijpen

**Innoveren**

* Nieuwe Databricks-features uittesten, zoals serverless compute, Genie en Mosaic AI, en waar zinvol integreren
* CI/CD opzetten met Databricks Asset Bundles en Git (Azure DevOps of GitHub)
* Continu zoeken naar manieren om pipelines sneller, stabieler of goedkoper te maken, met oog voor clusterconfiguratie, Photon en DBU-verbruik

**Wie ben jij?**

Je combineert sterke technische vaardigheden met een goed gevoel voor de business achter de data.

Je begrijpt dat een pipeline pas geslaagd is wanneer de data die eruit komt betrouwbaar, bruikbaar en schaalbaar is.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

* Idealiter drie jaar ervaring (of meer) als Data Engineer, waarvan minstens een deel hands-on in Databricks
* Diepgaande kennis van Apache Spark, Delta Lake en Unity Catalog
* Kennis van de volledige data lifecycle: van datamodellering en ETL/ELT tot governance, security en deployment
* Diepgaande kennis van dimensionele modellen volgens Kimball en moderne lakehouse-architecturen
* SQL, Python en PySpark zijn jouw krachtigste tools om data te structureren, transformeren en optimaliseren
* Ervaring met een cloudplatform (bij voorkeur Azure, met ADLS en Azure Data Factory) en tools als dbt is een sterke troef
* Een certificering als Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate of Professional is een plus, of je bent bereid ze te behalen
* Je kan vlot schakelen tussen business en IT
* Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands en Engels
* Je denkt in oplossingen, niet in problemen
* Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en je deelt graag kennis
* Je hebt gevoel voor humor (dat helpt meer dan je denkt)

**Waarom consultants voor EpicData kiezen**

**Omdat je impact maakt**

Je werkt mee aan projecten die organisaties écht vooruithelpen. Geen eindeloze statusmeetings of rapporten voor in de schuif, maar oplossingen die dagdagelijks gebruikt worden.

**Omdat je blijft groeien**

Of je nu starter bent of expert: je krijgt ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

* Tweewekelijkse Lunch & Learns
* Driemaandelijkse Learning Labs
* Ieder jaar een eigen Personal Development Plan
* Tijd & budget om te leren, certificeren én experimenteren

**Omdat AI geen buzzword is**

Van analyse en development tot documentatie en klantinteractie: we gebruiken AI dagelijks om slimmer, sneller én beter te werken. Iedere Epic'er krijgt toegang tot state-of-the-art tools zodat je vanaf dag één mee bent met de technologie van morgen.

**Omdat je dicht bij huis werkt**

Onze klanten bevinden zich tussen Brussel en Antwerpen.

Sommige projecten duren twee weken, andere een jaar. We zoeken bewust projecten die aansluiten bij jouw expertise én je woon-werksituatie.

**Wat maakt EpicData écht anders?**

Wij geloven niet in afgelijnde functies.

We geloven in mensen die willen groeien.

Wil je doorgroeien naar andere technologieën? Data Architect? Team Lead? Data Strategist? Project Manager? Partner?

Dan helpen we je daar graag gericht naartoe.

Jij bepaalt de richting én je snelheid. Wij zorgen voor de kansen.

**Omdat je erbij hoort**

Bij EpicData sta je er niet alleen voor. Je maakt deel uit van een inclusief & hecht team dat voor elkaar dé extra mile gaat: collega's die inspringen wanneer het nodig is, meedenken wanneer het kan en regelmatig samen hun successen vieren. Van afterworks tot teambuildings, activiteiten met het team zijn geen uitzondering maar een gewoonte en op elkaar kunnen rekenen is dé norm.

**EpicData HQ**

Daarnaast krijg je ook toegang tot ons *Epic* kantoor:

* Gratis warm buffet elke middag
* Fantastisch dakterras met lekkere koffie
* Eigen cinemazaal, gebedsruimte, pooltafel, kicker én darts
* Padelvelden aan het kantoor
* Wekelijkse Afterwork op vrijdag
* Jaarlijkse Workation
* Jaarlijkse Bike Challenge

**En natuurlijk...**

Is er ook een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met héél wat extralegale voordelen. Je rijdt rond met een leuke bedrijfswagen mét een Benelux-laadkaart, of kom je liever met de fiets, dan is er ook een fietsvergoeding. Daarnaast geniet je van de flexibiliteit van een cafetariaplan. Je krijgt een dagelijkse maaltijdvergoeding en hoeft nooit zelf je gsm- of internetabonnement thuis te betalen. Elk jaar krijg je ecocheques en een koopkrachtpremie erbovenop. Ook aan je rust, gezondheid en toekomst is gedacht: met 31 verlofdagen bouw je ruim tijd op om je batterijen op te laden en dankzij een hospitalisatie-, ambulante en groepsverzekering zit je goed verzekerd.

Daarnaast hebben we ook het EpicData Rewards-programma, waarmee je extra euro's kan verdienen door EpicData mee vooruit te helpen.

Liever je eigen verloningspakket kiezen? Ook dat kan: bij EpicData maak je evengoed de sprong naar freelancer, met een vast tarief ongeacht de klant waarvoor je aan de slag gaat.

**Meer weten?**

Kijk dan zeker even op onze socials: LinkedIn, Instagram of op onze FAQ over werken bij EpicData.

**Klaar om impact te maken?!**

Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en kom langs voor een lunch op ons kantoor.

Dan ontdekken we samen of jouw volgende carrièrestap even Epic kan worden als wij denken.

See you soon!

* Klanten adviseren hoe ze Fabric kunnen inzetten in hun processen, of hoe ze vanuit Azure Synapse, Data Factory of SQL Server naar Fabric migreren
* Meedenken over workspace-structuur, capacity-sizing en governance
* Meebeslissen over de juiste aanpak, of dat nu als teamspeler, expert of technisch aanspreekpunt is
* Technische keuzes vertalen naar taal die niet-technische collega's en klanten begrijpen

**Innoveren**

* Nieuwe Fabric-features uittesten, zoals Real-Time Intelligence (Eventstreams, Eventhouse, KQL) en Copilot in Fabric, en waar zinvol integreren
* CI/CD opzetten met Git-integratie (Azure DevOps of GitHub) en deployment pipelines
* Continu zoeken naar manieren om pipelines sneller, stabieler of goedkoper te maken, met oog voor Capacity Unit-verbruik

**Wie ben jij?**

Je combineert sterke technische vaardigheden met een goed gevoel voor de business achter de data.

Je begrijpt dat een pipeline pas geslaagd is wanneer de data die eruit komt betrouwbaar, bruikbaar en schaalbaar is.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

* Idealiter drie jaar ervaring (of meer) als Data Engineer, waarvan minstens een deel hands-on in Microsoft Fabric
* Kennis van de volledige data lifecycle: van datamodellering & ETL tot governance en deployment
* Diepgaande kennis van dimensionele modellen volgens Kimball tot moderne lakehouse-architecturen
* SQL en Python en PySpark zijn jouw krachtigste tools om data te structureren, transformeren en optimaliseren
* Ervaring met het bredere Microsoft-dataplatform (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, SQL Server, Power BI) is een sterke troef
* Een certificering als Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700) of Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600) is een plus, of je bent bereid ze te behalen
* Je kan vlot schakelen tussen business en IT
* Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands en Engels
* Je denkt in oplossingen, niet in problemen
* Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en je deelt graag kennis
* Je hebt gevoel voor humor (dat helpt meer dan je denkt)

**Waarom consultants voor EpicData kiezen**

**Omdat je impact maakt**

Je werkt mee aan projecten die organisaties écht vooruithelpen. Geen eindeloze statusmeetings of rapporten voor in de schuif, maar oplossingen die dagdagelijks gebruikt worden.

**Omdat je blijft groeien**

Of je nu starter bent of expert: je krijgt ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

* Tweewekelijkse Lunch & Learns
* Driemaandelijkse Learning Labs
* Ieder jaar een eigen Personal Development Plan
* Tijd & budget om te leren, certificeren én experimenteren

**Omdat AI geen buzzword is**

Van analyse en development tot documentatie en klantinteractie: we gebruiken AI dagelijks om slimmer, sneller én beter te werken. Iedere Epic'er krijgt toegang tot state-of-the-art tools zodat je vanaf dag één mee bent met de technologie van morgen.

**Omdat je dicht bij huis werkt**

Onze klanten bevinden zich tussen Brussel en Antwerpen.

Sommige projecten duren twee weken, andere een jaar. We zoeken bewust projecten die aansluiten bij jouw expertise én je woon-werksituatie.

**Wat maakt EpicData écht anders?**

Wij geloven niet in afgelijnde functies.

We geloven in mensen die willen groeien.

Wil je doorgroeien naar andere technologieën? Data Architect? Team Lead? Data Strategist? Project Manager? Partner?

Dan helpen we je daar graag gericht naartoe.

Jij bepaalt de richting én je snelheid. Wij zorgen voor de kansen.

**Omdat je erbij hoort**

Bij EpicData sta je er niet alleen voor. Je maakt deel uit van een inclusief & hecht team dat voor elkaar dé extra mile gaat: collega's die inspringen wanneer het nodig is, meedenken wanneer het kan en regelmatig samen hun successen vieren. Van afterworks tot teambuildings, activiteiten met het team zijn geen uitzondering maar een gewoonte en op elkaar kunnen rekenen is dé norm.

**EpicData HQ**

Daarnaast krijg je ook toegang tot ons *Epic* kantoor:

* Gratis warm buffet elke middag
* Fantastisch dakterras met lekkere koffie
* Eigen cinemazaal, gebedsruimte, pooltafel, kicker én darts
* Padelvelden aan het kantoor
* Wekelijkse Afterwork op vrijdag
* Jaarlijkse Workation
* Jaarlijkse Bike Challenge

**En natuurlijk...**

Is er ook een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met héél wat extralegale voordelen. Je rijdt rond met een leuke bedrijfswagen mét een Benelux-laadkaart, of kom je liever met de fiets, dan is er ook een fietsvergoeding. Daarnaast geniet je van de flexibiliteit van een cafetariaplan. Je krijgt een dagelijkse maaltijdvergoeding en hoeft nooit zelf je gsm- of internetabonnement thuis te betalen. Elk jaar krijg je ecocheques en een koopkrachtpremie erbovenop. Ook aan je rust, gezondheid en toekomst is gedacht: met 31 verlofdagen bouw je ruim tijd op om je batterijen op te laden en dankzij een hospitalisatie-, ambulante en groepsverzekering zit je goed verzekerd.

Daarnaast hebben we ook het EpicData Rewards-programma, waarmee je extra euro's kan verdienen door EpicData mee vooruit te helpen.

Liever je eigen verloningspakket kiezen? Ook dat kan: bij EpicData maak je evengoed de sprong naar freelancer, met een vast tarief ongeacht de klant waarvoor je aan de slag gaat.

**Meer weten?**

Kijk dan zeker even op onze socials: LinkedIn, Instagram of op onze FAQ over werken bij EpicData.

**Klaar om impact te maken?!**

Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en kom langs voor een lunch op ons kantoor.

Dan ontdekken we samen of jouw volgende carrièrestap even Epic kan worden als wij denken.

See you soon!

Interne Sozialberatung

Elvira Hadziisaku

Vorselektion durch externen Partner

Eingegangene Bewerbungen werden laufend durch unseren externen Partner geprüft. Dieser erstellt eine Vorselektion, führt mit Kandidat\*innen erste Gespräche und gibt uns die Unterlagen dann zur Ansicht frei. Das Gespräch wird mit der zuständigen Person aus dem HR und/oder der Fachabteilung virtuell oder vor Ort durchgeführt. Dabei geht es in erster Linie darum, mehr über die Personal- und Fachkompetenzen zu erfahren und gibt beiden Seiten die Möglichkeit, den kulturellen Fit ins Unternehmen und Team zu beurteilen. Dauer bis Rückmeldung: Bis zu drei Wochen

Kennenlernen Team

Ob jemand ins Team passt, ist für Arbeitnehmer\*innen und Arbeitgeber\*innen ein wichtiger Faktor bei der Entscheidung für oder gegen eine Anstellung. In einem ungezwungenen Rahmen geben wir deshalb die Möglichkeit, dass sich alle gegenseitig kennenlernen.

Fachgespräch mit Case-Präsentation

Es werden spezifische Fachkenntnisse anhand eines Cases oder anderen Assessment-Instrumenten geprüft. Nach der Bearbeitung wird das Resultat der Führungsperson präsentiert und anschliessend gemeinsam diskutiert. Üblicherweise ist auch das Team bei der Präsentation vertreten. In der Regel werden die Gespräche durch die vorgesetzte Person geführt, ohne Vertreter\*in aus dem HR. Dauer bis Rückmeldung: Bis zu drei Wochen

Angebot & Vertragsausstellung (Digital)

Nach unserem mündlichen Stellenangebot werden die wichtigsten Vertragspunkte nochmals verifiziert. Nach Übereinkunft wird die Vertragserstellung in Auftrag gegeben und zur digitalen Signatur per versendet. Dauer bis Rückmeldung: Bis zu einer Woche

Für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer (IT-CA-2026-236-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Are you passionate about software development and interested in supporting Open Data and Open Science in research? Join our team that is building services for open data and reproducible computational data analyses!

**Your responsibilities**

As a full-stack developer in our team, you will:

* Participate in the development of the REANA reproducible analysis platform allowing to run containerised declarative analysis workflows.
* Participate in the development of the LHCb Ntupling service allowing researchers to request custom open data from the LHCb experiment.
* Collaborate closely with LHC experimental physics teams working on open data and reproducible research.
* Collaborate with external institutes and partners working on open data, open science and reproducible analysis infrastructures.

**Your profile**

* Experience in full-stack software development and with frontend and backend software engineering technologies.
* Experience with container technologies and application deployment, monitoring and security.
* Some familiarity with basic principles of computational research data analyses would be a plus.

Skills

* Frontend technologies: React.
* Backend technologies: Python, Go.
* Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Computer Science or equivalent (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  
**Additional Information**

Job closing date: **25.10.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-December-2026

This position involves:

* Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
* Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Job reference: IT-CA-2026-236-GRAE

Field of work: Information Technologies

Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.title: Systems and Digital ASIC Engineer (EP-ESE-ME-2026-160-GRAP)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Join CERN's IC Technology R&D team and contribute to the development of advanced electronics for future particle detectors. We are seeking an engineer with expertise in system-level modelling and digital ASIC design to work at the interface between architecture-level simulation and hardware implementation. In this role, you will help develop and validate innovative electronic systems, bridging high-level design exploration with hands-on digital hardware development.

* Develop and use simulation models to study and optimise electronic systems for future particle detectors.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of digital integrated circuits based on system-level specifications.
* Support the verification and validation of electronic designs through simulation and testing.
* Collaborate with engineers, physicists and software developers on the development of advanced detector electronics.
* Help improve the performance, efficiency and reliability of electronic systems.
* Document designs, results and technical developments, and share knowledge within the team.
* This role includes team supervision responsibilities.

**Your profile**

* Knowledge of digital electronics and digital design gained through academic, research or personal projects.
* Familiarity with hardware description languages such as VHDL, Verilog or SystemVerilog.
* Understanding of system-level modelling, simulation and verification techniques.
* Interest in integrated circuit design and advanced electronics for scientific applications.
* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and collaborative environments.

Skills

* Good programming skills in C++ and familiarity with Python.
* Knowledge of digital design concepts and hardware description languages such as VHDL, Verilog or SystemVerilog.
* Familiarity with simulation, modelling and software development tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* You have a professional background in Electronics (or a related field) and have either:
  + a **Master's degree with 2 to 6 years** of post-graduation professional experience;
  + or a **PhD with no more than 3 years** of post-graduation professional experience.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

  
**Additional Information**

Job closing date: **25.10.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-February-2027

Job reference: EP-ESE-ME-2026-160-GRAP

Field of work: Electronics Engineering

Benchmark job: 200050 - Electronics Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

Our team is made up of hardworking software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales reps and play a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.

As MongoDB continues to expand product offerings and features within the MongoDB Atlas Data Platform, MongoDB is seeking an expert in application search. This role will focus on being a product specialist of Atlas Search within the presales organization. Beyond the normal tasks of a MongoDB Solutions Architect, this specialist role will operate in a worldwide team, assist in the most complex search deal cycles, assist in search enablement, and work closely with the Atlas Search product team to close the feedback loop and further enhance the product moving forward. This includes both lexical and semantic search offerings.

This role will be based remotely in Barcelona, Dublin & London.

### **As an ideal candidate, you will have**

* 3+ years of search expertise (Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, Algolia, Lucidworks, or similar)
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 3+ years of pre-sales experience with enterprise software
* Solid understanding and ability to code with two or more modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, etc) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C, C++, C#, Java, etc)
* Experience with scalable and highly available distributed systems
* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* Ability to travel approximately 25% of the time

### **You may also have**

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* A MongoDB Certification
* A major cloud provider certification

### **What you do at MongoDB**

* Design systems, applications, and infrastructure to help drive software development projects using MongoDB and the Atlas Developer Data Platform (DDP)
* Advise customers on architectures, patterns, and strategies for making the best use of MongoDB
* Expertly articulate the business value of MongoDB solutions
* Align to support sales with activities such as technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentation, sizing, and documentation of technical decision criteria; working across a number of opportunities in parallel
* Translate technical concepts and patterns into business benefits for management and executives
* Act as a liaison, collecting feedback from the field to relay back to the Product Management team
* Help drive demand through participation in both industry-known trade-shows as well account-based marketing events
* Demonstrate resilience and sound judgment in dealing with business challenges
* Proactively seek opportunities to support and mentor other pre-sales team members and share standard methodologies
* Help enable other solutions architects with knowledge on search technical and business concepts as well as build tools to allow other SAs to demonstrate these concepts
* Assist in the direction of Vector Search and AI/ML through taking customer needs and interactions to Product Management
* Embody MongoDB's core values in our interactions with internal teams and customers

### **What you will learn**

* The rapidly growing MongoDB product suite, including
* Core database server
* Atlas (fully managed cloud database service)
* The Atlas Developer Data Platform including Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, Atlas for the Edge, Realm, Charts, and Atlas Streams Processing
* Other Tools and connectors - Ops/Cloud Manager, Compass, Connector for BI, Connector for Spark
* Market-relevant, complementary technologies e.g. Apache Kafka, Kubernetes
* Modern and popular architecture design patterns, methodologies and concerns e.g. microservices, DevOps, cloud, security

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

* Desarrollo de aplicaciones para dispositivos móviles.

jobs.title: QA Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
* **Location**
  ------------

  Calle Bergara 13
    
  8002 Barcelona
* **Employment Area**
  -------------------

  IT - Development
* **Level**
  ---------

  Experienced professionals
* **Working Model**
  -----------------

  Full-time
* **Reference ID**
  ----------------

  48350

Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.
  
  
Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group.

### **Your Tasks**

* Design, implement, and maintain reliable automated test suites for web applications, mobile app and microservices aligned with business requirements.
* Collaborate actively within a multidisciplinary, international Squad (Developers, DevOps, UX/UI, Tech Lead, Product Owner, Product Manager) towards continuous delivery and high quality.
* Take ownership of testing strategy within the squad, managing test preparation, execution, and reporting from feature conception to production deployment.
* Perform end-to-end API testing (RESTful services), ensuring functional accuracy, performance, and data integrity.
* Implement and execute BDD (Behavior-Driven Development)
* Build and maintain web and app automation scripts using modern tools like Playwright and Selenium.
* Champion quality assurance best practices and integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with developers to ensure fast and efficient resolution.

### **Your Profile**

* 3+ years of experience working as a Quality Assurance / Test Automation Engineer.
* A native team player capable of working effectively within small, heterogeneous, and agile international teams.
* Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) to communicate effectively within an international team and collaborate across different stakeholders.
* Outstanding QA Soft Skills: Strong critical thinking, meticulous attention to detail, constructive communication, and empathy when delivering feedback or documenting defects to foster a collaborative culture with developers.
* Solid hands-on experience in API Testing (REST APIs) using tools like Postman, Bruno, or code-based libraries (Requests, RestAssured, Robot Framework).
* Proven expertise in Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Behave (or similar Gherkin-based frameworks like Cucumber/SpecFlow).
* Strong practical experience in Web UI Automation using Playwright and/or Selenium.
* Good skills in a programming language suitable for automation test frameworks (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#).
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests into deployment flows.
* A proactive and growth-oriented mindset-an eager learner, passionate about continuously advancing their QA skills, exploring new testing tools, and staying up-to-date with quality practices.
* Deep understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, bug life cycle management, and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
* A hands-on mindset-you take ownership of quality and test execution from planning to release

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Type:**

Permanent

**Build a brilliant future with Hiscox**

**The role**

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic professional who will be a key and influential member of our Hiscox London Market Engineering Team, within the Software Engineering Chapter. In this role you will be working in one of our various squads as we create new “Cloud First” solutions to add value to the business, while supporting and transforming our existing on-prem and cloud systems. We are looking for someone who is aligned with modern software engineering practices and ready to embrace the use of AI enabled development tool and adapt to the ever changing space as we enter the agentic SDLC phase to allow rapid delivery of high quality value.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Work collaboratively with your squad and stakeholders to contribute to delivering business outcomes
* Write clean, maintainable code following best practices such as SOLID principles, design patterns, unit testing, peer review, and CI/CD processes
* Ensure documentation are up to date and detailed comments added to the stories
* Support team members by learning from others and sharing knowledge as you grow in your role
* Assist in designing solutions and implementing changes based on requirements
* Collaborate with engineers across teams to learn about and contribute to our architecture
* Ensure your work follows security and engineering standards with support from the team
* Be open to learning and adopting new ways of working, including AI-assisted development tools and ever changing space as we enter agentic SDLC phase
* Work collaboratively with team members located in the United Kingdom, Portugal, Poland, and India to deliver value

**Skills**:

* Academic degree in a closely related field (or 3+ years employment in a Software Engineering role)
* Candidates should have a strong foundation and hands-on experience in C# and .NET, with the ability to write and maintain effective unit tests.
* Should have a solid background in SQL and be comfortable working with relational databases
* Should have knowledge on CI/CD pipelines and a good understanding of source control systems and branching strategies
* Exposure to Azure technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, and Azure API Management (APIM) would be considered an advantage
* Knowledge on Azure Service Bus would be advantageous, particularly in event-driven or messaging-based architectures.
* Familiarity with modern front-end technologies such as Blazor/Angular/React would be beneficial for building responsive and user-friendly applications.

### **Behaviours**

* Demonstrates enthusiasm for learning new technologies, tools, and ways of working, actively seeking opportunities to grow technical and professional skills.
* Takes ownership of assigned tasks and delivers work to agreed standards with appropriate support and guidance.
* Communicates clearly and respectfully with colleagues, asking thoughtful questions and sharing progress proactively.
* Collaborates effectively with teammates and contributes positively to an inclusive and supportive team environment.
* Shows curiosity about the business, customers, and products, seeking to understand how their work contributes to business outcomes.
* Follows established engineering standards, development practices, and security requirements, while building a strong foundation in software engineering principles.
* Approaches challenges with a positive mindset, demonstrating resilience and a willingness to learn from mistakes and feedback.
* Adapts to changing priorities and embraces new ways of working in a fast-paced environment.
* Seeks and acts upon feedback to continuously improve technical skills, effectiveness, and professional development.
* Demonstrates attention to detail and a commitment to producing reliable, well-tested, and maintainable solutions.
* Contributes ideas and suggestions for improving processes, team practices, and customer outcomes.
* Builds positive working relationships through professionalism, respect, empathy, and a willingness to support others.
* Takes responsibility for personal learning and development and actively participates in knowledge-sharing opportunities.
* Demonstrates a growth mindset, showing initiative and motivation to broaden technical expertise and industry knowledge.

**Diversity and flexible working at Hiscox:**

At Hiscox we care about our people. We hire the best people for the job and we’re committed to diversity and creating a truly inclusive culture, which we believe drives success.

We have also learned over the past couple of years that working life doesn’t always have to be in the office, and have adopted hybrid ways of working to encourage a healthy work life balance.

We see it as the best of both worlds: structure and sociability on one hand, and independence and flexibility on the other.

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we’d still love to hear from you.

*Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture*

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives.

Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.  
Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Risk Management Engineer or Project Controls Engineer with risk management experience to join our organization in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and mitigating project risks while maintaining robust project controls across multiple initiatives. You will work collaboratively with project teams, stakeholders, and senior management to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, technical proficiency, and the ability to communicate complex risk and control information effectively to diverse audiences.

* Acting as the Risk facilitator for a large aviation/ airport project.
* Implementing the Risk Management Plan and supporting project teams in applying the risk management process.
* Facilitating risk workshops with project stakeholders.
* Maintaining risk registers and ensuring risks and associated actions are updated accordingly.
* Preparing monthly and ad hoc risk reports.
* Undertaking ad hoc Quantitative Risk Assessments (QRAs), where required, outside of the formal Risk Management Plan and delivery governance framework.
* Maintaining a strong focus on risk mitigation plans and proactively following up with action owners to ensure timely completion of agreed actions.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 3 - 5+ years of experience in risk management, project controls, or related project management discipline
* Demonstrated expertise in risk identification, assessment, and mitigation planning
* Proficiency in project management software and tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent)
* Experience developing and maintaining risk registers and control documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings to senior stakeholders
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and collaborate across multiple project teams
* Background in construction, engineering, or infrastructure project delivery or planning / project controls functions within a PMC/PMO environment is desired

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

**About the Role**
------------------

The GM Risk and Capital Optimization Technology team is seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Senior DevOps Engineer** to join the TAROT platform team based in London.

This is a key technical role responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting the DevOps capabilities that underpin a suite of strategic risk and capital optimization solutions. The successful candidate will drive automation, improve software delivery processes, enhance operational resilience, and ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of the platform.

Working closely with software engineers, architects, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders, the Senior DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in modernizing development and deployment practices, streamlining release management, and supporting mission-critical applications within a highly regulated financial services environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **DevOps Engineering & Automation**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade DevOps frameworks and best practices.
* Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to support automated build, test, deployment, and release processes.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first approaches across application and platform environments.
* Automate operational processes, environment provisioning, and deployment activities to improve efficiency and reduce risk.
* Continuously improve software delivery lifecycle processes, deployment frequency, and release quality.

### **Source Control & Release Management**

* Manage and administer source code repositories, branching strategies, and release processes.
* Support application versioning, release governance, and deployment planning across multiple environments.
* Implement best practices for code promotion, artifact management, and release automation.
* Collaborate with development teams to ensure consistent development standards and deployment practices.

### **Environment & Platform Management**

* Support multiple application environments including development, testing, UAT, and production.
* Manage application hosting platforms and ensure platform stability, availability, and performance.
* Monitor platform health and proactively identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.
* Support disaster recovery, resilience, and business continuity requirements.

### **Infrastructure & Operations**

* Work closely with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to ensure platforms are secure, scalable, and compliant.
* Manage Windows Server environments supporting business-critical applications.
* Administer and support IIS-hosted applications and web services.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and application performance issues across environments.
* Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational readiness initiatives.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Embed security controls and DevSecOps principles into the software delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise technology standards, risk controls, and operational procedures.
* Support platform vulnerability remediation, patch management, and audit requirements.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to enhance security automation and monitoring capabilities.

### **Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with software engineering teams to improve development workflows and deployment automation.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers on DevOps best practices and operational excellence.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to platform modernization initiatives.
* Act as a subject matter expert for DevOps tooling, automation, and operational support.

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

### **Experience**

* Significant experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering role.
* Proven experience designing and maintaining enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience supporting complex, business-critical applications in production environments.
* Strong experience working within financial services, banking, capital markets, or other regulated industries is highly desirable.
  

  

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

### **Essential**

* Strong experience with CI/CD tools and automated deployment frameworks.
* Extensive knowledge of source control systems and repository management.
* Strong Windows Server administration experience.
* Strong Microsoft technology stack expertise.
* Hands-on experience administering and supporting IIS (Internet Information Services).
* Experience with release management, deployment automation, and software delivery lifecycle management.
* Strong troubleshooting and operational support capabilities.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance management tools.

### **Desirable**

* Python scripting and automation development.
* PowerShell scripting and Windows automation.
* Infrastructure as Code technologies.
* Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Cloud platform experience (Azure preferred).
* Experience with application monitoring and observability platforms.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with SonarQube, security scanning, and code quality tooling.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.

new_jobs.title: Senior Lösningsarkitekt / Solution Architect - Malmö eller Kalmar
new_jobs.description:
Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för lösningar där verksamhetsbehov, komplexa systemlandskap och modern Microsoft-teknik behöver fungera tillsammans?  
CGI söker en erfaren Senior Lösningsarkitekt / Solution Architect till vårt team i Malmö eller Kalmar. Vi söker dig som är trygg i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och teknik och som kan omsätta komplexa behov till hållbara lösningar – från tidig dialog och arkitektur till genomförande.  
I rollen får du arbeta med lösningar där flera system, plattformar, integrationer och dataflöden behöver samspela. Du kommer nära både kunden och våra tekniska team och får en central roll i att skapa riktning, fatta lösningsbeslut och se till att helheten håller över tid.  
Du behöver ha ett tekniskt djup och förstå hur moderna lösningar byggs, men det här är inte en roll där du förväntas detaljstyra implementationen. Din styrka ligger i att se helheten, ställa rätt frågor och samla rätt kompetenser kring rätt lösning.

**Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter**

Som Senior Lösningsarkitekt arbetar du från verksamhetsbehov och krav till sammanhängande lösningsarkitektur.  
Du leder lösningsdiskussioner tillsammans med kund, verksamhet, utvecklingsteam, tekniska arkitekter och andra specialister. Du analyserar alternativ och beroenden och hjälper kunden att fatta välgrundade beslut utifrån verksamhetsnytta, teknik, kostnad och långsiktig förvaltning.  
Du kommer bland annat att:  

* designa och driva end-to-end-lösningar i komplexa systemlandskap
* omsätta verksamhetsbehov, processer och krav till hållbar lösningsarkitektur
* leda workshops, lösningsdiskussioner och arkitekturella vägval tillsammans med kund och tekniska team
* säkerställa att system, plattformar, integrationer och komponenter fungerar tillsammans som en helhet
* arbeta med integrationer, API, dataflöden och systemberoenden
* utvärdera lösningsalternativ och driva beslut från behov och målbild till realiserbar lösning
* vägleda och utmana utvecklare och tekniska arkitekter med stöd av din förståelse för systemutveckling, .NET och C#
* identifiera risker, beroenden och arkitekturella konsekvenser tidigt
* involvera rätt specialister och delegera tekniska frågeställningar till rätt kompetens
* kommunicera komplexa lösningar på ett begripligt sätt för både verksamhet, ledning och tekniska målgrupper.

**Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll**

Vem söker vi?  
Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet som Solution Architect, Lösningsarkitekt eller i en motsvarande senior arkitektroll och som har arbetat med lösningar där flera system och tekniska plattformar behöver fungera tillsammans.  
  
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:  

* senior erfarenhet av att designa och driva sammanhängande lösningar i komplexa systemlandskap
* förmåga att förstå verksamhetsprocesser och krav och omsätta dem till hållbara tekniska lösningar
* god förståelse för systemutveckling och .NET/C#, med tillräckligt tekniskt djup för att kunna utmana och vägleda utvecklingsteam och tekniska arkitekter
* erfarenhet av systemintegration, API, integrationsarkitektur och dataflöden
* förmåga att se hela lösningen och förstå beroenden mellan applikationer, plattformar och integrationer
* erfarenhet av att leda lösningsdiskussioner, utvärdera alternativ och driva arkitekturella beslut
* mycket god förmåga att kommunicera med såväl verksamhet och kund som utvecklare och tekniska specialister
* trygghet i att arbeta i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter, beroenden och förändrade förutsättningar
* mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Extra intressant är erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och Power Platform  
Vi ser det som starkt meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 och Power Platform, särskilt om du har designat lösningar där plattformarna behöver samverka med andra verksamhetssystem.  
Det kan exempelvis handla om lösningsarkitektur kring:  
Dynamics 365 • Power Platform • Power Apps • Power Automate • Dataverse • API Management • Integrationer • Azure  
  
Du behöver inte vara specialist eller utvecklare inom samtliga tekniker. Vi söker framför allt dig som förstår hur plattformarna kan användas som delar av en större lösning och hur integrationer, data och övriga verksamhetssystem behöver hänga ihop.  
  
Det är också meriterande om du har  

* erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och Microsofts bredare plattformsekosystem
* erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA, framför allt ur ett lösnings-, arkitektur- eller integrationsperspektiv
* erfarenhet av större digitaliserings- eller transformationsprogram där flera system, plattformar och verksamhetsområden berörs
* arbetat i miljöer där Microsoft-plattformar, ERP, CRM och andra verksamhetssystem behöver integreras till en sammanhängande lösning.

  
Vem är du?  
För oss är det viktigt att du kan skapa både riktning och samsyn.  
Du är lösningsorienterad och driver frågor framåt även när alla svar ännu inte finns på plats. Du kan snabbt skapa dig en bild av helheten och är pragmatisk när du behöver balansera verksamhetsnytta, tekniska möjligheter, tid, kostnad och långsiktig förvaltning.  
Du är kommunikativ och pedagogisk och kan växla mellan att diskutera verksamhetsprocesser med kunden och tekniska vägval med arkitekter och utvecklare.  
Samtidigt är du prestigelös. Du behöver inte själv äga varje teknisk detalj, utan vet när andra kompetenser ska involveras och får olika specialister att arbeta mot samma mål.  
  
Varför CGI?  
Hos CGI får du möjlighet att arbeta med affärskritiska lösningar och komplexa digitala transformationer hos några av våra kunder. Du får kombinera din arkitekturkompetens med CGI breda kompetens inom bland annat Microsoft, integration, ERP, cloud och verksamhetsutveckling.  
Som Senior Lösningsarkitekt får du möjlighet att påverka lösningen från tidigt skede och arbeta nära både kund och våra leveransteam.  
Du blir samtidigt en del av ett stort nätverk av arkitekter, utvecklare och specialister där vi delar kunskap och tillsammans löser komplexa utmaningar.  
  
Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta t.karlsson@cgi.com. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!  
  
#LI-HW1

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**  
  
Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.  
  
Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.  
  
Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.  
  
Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
  
  
Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

  

**Job Title:**

Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio

**NHG Vision: Adding years of healthy life**

  

**CHI Mission: Driving innovation for systems change**

  

The Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) is committed to catalysing and driving innovation for systems change in healthcare, thereby adding years of healthy life. Built on the foundation of co-learning and collaboration, CHI’s core is in facilitating innovation through its suite of platforms and programmes. CHI has built a dynamic network of local and international partners who are dedicated to fostering innovation, creating thought leadership, co-building initiatives to inculcate and embed a culture of innovation within healthcare. We spearhead innovation by driving the adoption of the CHI Innovation Cycle, care and process redesign and in the use of technology. CHI leads transformation at the care, systems and ecosystem levels to achieve better health and healthcare.

  

**About the Digital Innovation Office (DIO)**

  

The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).

DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.

**JOB SUMMARY**

  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Studio (DIS), the role will manage DIS’s proof-of-concept (POC) platforms consisting of multi-cloud sandbox environments and maintain full technical understanding of their AI and/or IT standards. The candidate will undertake important technical activities together with NHG project teams for the robust prototyping of digital solutions that support CHI’s digital and AI-enabled future.

  

In addition, the candidate will participate in user-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.

**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

1. **Technical Prototype Engineering**

* Design and support the development of lightweight prototypes, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and workflow components.
* Collaborate with project teams to define technical requirements and translate business needs into implementable solution designs, ensuring alignment with security and scalability considerations.
* Develop technical documentation such as PRDs that include human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflow and guardrail/safety mechanisms, and architecture diagrams.
* Provide hands-on support for prototype development, testing, and technical troubleshooting.

**2. Sandbox Platform Management**
----------------------------------

* Maintain DIS multi-cloud sandbox environments across AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including user onboarding, resource provisioning, and access management .
* Manage and optimise additional enterprise prototyping platforms, ensuring users can effectively build solutions using pre-established services and reusable architecture patterns.
* Engage industry cloud providers and healthcare IT vendors to stay abreast of emerging platforms, integration approaches, and capabilities, and advise project teams on designing prototypes aligned with target deployment environments.
  

**3. Administrative support**

* Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
* Design and deliver hands-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud-based tools and platforms.
  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

  

(A) EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 5 years hands-on engineering experience (front-end or back-end in cloud environment).
* Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low-code/no-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Proficient in drafting PRDs and creating pragmatic lightweight solution architectures to guide technical implementation
  

**Desired Skills**

* Passion for healthcare and to create new solutions that can benefit patients or hospital systems.
* Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
* Flexible mindset to adopt new platforms and create new technical frameworks or processes in our evolving environment
